findings.title: Dynamic SQL String Interpolation
findings.description: Template string interpolation used in database query call.
findings.threat: Potential SQL injection if interpolated variable originates from untrusted user input.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries ($1, $2) or Drizzle ORM expression builders.

findings.title: Unescaped HTML Rendering (dangerouslySetInnerHTML/eval)
findings.description: Raw HTML rendering found without obvious DOMPurify sanitization.
findings.threat: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) if content contains user-supplied inputs.
findings.remediation: Sanitize content with DOMPurify.sanitize() before rendering.
